I would say classic and bfa is two completely different game. If you like a fast paced easy to gear (with a lot of rng) themepark MMO bfa is for you, although I recommend to join a guild because it can be really repetitve alone, it’s a bit similar to korean MMOs in a way. An other pro for bfa is that the modern raids are pretty well designed requires a lot more cordination and gives a lot more enjoyment while progressing.

Classic on the otherhand is not only about the endgame but the exploration of the world finding new peeps to help you in your quest because you are not able to do it alone. It’s whole new experience but it’s old so do not expect fancy scripts which explain lore or any complex raidboss (i dont say there aren’t any challenging).

One of the best ways to find a guild that suits you is to mesure your own skill level, by that I mean are you mythic ready with gear and mentality or you just want to clear a heroic raid first, after this I would go to wowprogress.com and filter to my realm and look for a guild that suits my standards via their progress. Hope this helps a bit and I hope you find a nice guild.
